locked_story.headline: Two Alaska cities met the limits of AI in the same week, and neither one had voted on it
locked_story.outlets: Alaska's News Source (KTUU), Joe Allgood; KUAC, Patrick Gilchrist, syndicated by Alaska Public Media
locked_story.why_this_one: IN WINDOW by one to two days, both stories genuinely about AI in production in named Alaska governments, and a natural pair that no outlet has connected. Anchorage: object recognition on license plate readers arrives inside a $600,000 audio-visual purchase, the Assembly's 2023 ban covers FACES and nothing was written for objects, and the vote is postponed to August 18th. Fairbanks: a city bought AI to make public-records redaction affordable, it can't keep up, and the chief of staff's proposed remedy is to slow-walk the requests instead. Two cities, one week, opposite failure modes, same missing step. This also rotates the subject hard away from the data-center siting story this channel has run five times in 30 days, and it is the first dispatch on policing technology or public-records mechanics.
locked_story.dedupe_note: scripts/dedupe.py check returns DUP on the bare tokens 'center' and 'public', colliding with the 2026-07-12 beluga-hoax dispatch (Alaska SeaLife Center, Alaska Public Media). That is a pure generic-token false positive of exactly the kind the routine warns about twice ('a token collision cost this channel a scoop'). Viewer's test: nobody who watched a dispatch about an AI-generated beluga photo going viral would feel they are being shown the same story as an Anchorage Assembly fight over a police video wall. No shared actor, mechanism, institution or question. The entity list was NOT trimmed to force a FRESH verdict. The defect in dedupe.py, which matches on single generic words like 'center', 'public', 'data' and 'decision', is logged for the Phase 8 fix.

story_switch_note: This run locked a story, then RE-LOCKED after the fourth researcher returned. The first lock was the tribal health AI governance paper (cand-1 below), which was correct on the evidence available at the time: three of four beats had reported the window genuinely thin, and the best thing in hand was a strong unreported out-of-window paper. The wildcard beat then returned two IN-WINDOW stories that are both squarely about AI in production in Alaska governments and that pair into one thesis. In-window and genuinely-AI beats out-of-window and genuinely-AI, so the lock moved. Recorded rather than quietly overwritten. The tribal health paper is not discarded: its fact-check was already commissioned and its verified claims are being written to queue/next_story.json so a future run inherits the expensive part.

candidates.title: Adaptive acoustic monitoring for endangered Cook Inlet beluga whales (Marine Mammal Science, 2026-06-07)
candidates.verdict: REJECTED, SUBJECT SATURATION plus UNVERIFIABLE NUMBERS
candidates.reason: Strong AI content and a real Alaska agency author list (NOAA Anchorage, ADF&G Juneau). Two problems. First, it would be the third Cook Inlet beluga item in about 40 days (06-24 acoustic AI, 07-23 GAIA satellite vision). The 06-24 dispatch was ALSO a beluga passive-acoustic AI story, which makes this close to an exact repeat of subject and mechanism. Second, Wiley returned 403, so only the abstract could be read and no precision, recall or hours-of-audio figure could be verified. A film cannot put a performance number on screen it could not fetch.

candidates.title: Aleutian Thunder: an ANCSA corporation's 8(a) joint venture as a sole-source channel for agentic AI into federal agencies
candidates.reason: Genuinely unreported and structurally interesting. The entire evidentiary base is one PR Newswire release issued by the company itself plus the joint venture's own marketing page. Every load-bearing claim (the procurement advantage, the ceilings, the shareholder benefit) is the company's framing of its own launch, with no independent reporting and no filing to check it against. The accuracy rules require load-bearing numbers cross-checked against a second source, and there is no second source that is not the same party.
